messages:
maria: Heads up — targeting v1.8.0 release TOMORROW 10:00 PDT. Need version bumps across api, runtime, console, and SDKs. Please list PRs and blockers.

cheng: Runtime PR #452 ready (kv-cache refactor). Bumped Cargo.toml in runtime repo, but note ABI change — runtime consumers (api) will need to update call site. Command I used:
```
git checkout release/v1.8
sed -i 's/^version = .*/version = "1.8.0"/' Cargo.toml
```
I'll hold off on pushing release tag until API merges.

oliver: API PR #387 is open, waiting on integration tests. I updated openapi.yaml version to 1.8.0 and added changelog entry. ETA merge ~2 hours. ping @sam for SDKs.

sam: Ack. SDK generator needs the new nullable field in responses. I'll run patch gen after API merge. Publishing plan:
```
# for npm
npm version 1.8.0 --no-git-tag-version
npm publish --tag next
```
Don't publish stable until runtime is tagged.

ivy: Console change landed in console/feature/flags v1.8-bump. Staging deploy failed flakily on e2e; investigating. If not green by cutoff I'll revert the console bump to avoid blocking.

release-bot: Reminder: release cutoff in 14h 12m. Run `/release checklist` to validate all repos. :alarm_clock:

maria: Thx. Quick checklist: 1) API merged and tag pushed 2) Runtime tag + changelog 3) SDK artifacts built but not published 4) Console staging green or revert 5) Update release notes in CHANGELOG.md across repos. Post a message here once your repo is tagged.

cheng: tagging runtime now: `git tag -a v1.8.0 -m "runtime v1.8.0" && git push origin v1.8.0` — pushed.

oliver: API merged and tagged v1.8.0, CI green. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/387

sam: SDKs built locally, creating PRs to bump package.json versions in each language binding. PRs:
- js-sdk: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/221
- py-sdk: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/112

ivy: Staging passed green, console tag pushed: v1.8.0. Running quick smoke.

maria: Great — final: hold publish until we confirm runtime + api tags exist. After publish, I'll cut release notes and notify marketing. Thanks everyone :tada:
